summary: Prompt LLM has 30 s race timeout that does not cancel the request; LLM client retries 3 times. Image provider retries 3 times with backoff and has no request timeout.
notes: Timer not cleared after success.

title: Concurrency model
summary: Stage 9 prompt generation is strictly sequential per shot (two LLM calls each). Stage 10 generate-frames creates jobs sequentially but provider calls run concurrently in-process with no limit.
notes: Two concurrent regenerations of one frame race on frames write.

title: Frame cost tracking
summary: frames.total_cost_credits is incremented only when /status is called on a completed job, which the UI never does; scene cost falls back to summing completed jobs.
notes: Repeated /status calls would double count (no idempotency).

title: Stage 9 vs Stage 10 end reference order precedence
summary: Any non-empty end_frame_reference_image_order is used verbatim as user override, so the within_shot post-transformation swap runs only when that column is empty. Stage 9 writes that column whenever assignments exist.
notes: Code-level inference only; runtime UNKNOWN.

title: Sort order contradiction in asset manifest
summary: Docstring says characters then locations then props; code sorts location 0, character 1, prop 2; test expects locations first.
notes: Code is the behavior.
